summary: node1 now has an ext4 logical volume mounted at /srv/data. It was grown online from 1.00 GiB to 2.25 GiB without unmounting or changing its contents, and it recovered successfully after a full node restart. Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Created the vgdata volume group and lvdata logical volume using a persistent loop-backed physical volume.
Mounted lvdata at /srv/data and created a checksum-verified proof file.
Extended the mounted LV and ext4 filesystem online from 1.00 GiB to 2.25 GiB.
Enabled an OpenRC service to restore the loop device, LVM activation, and mount during boot.
Restarted node1 and verified its changed boot identity, recovered service, mount, LV size, and preserved data.

evidence.requirement: Provide a logical volume mounted at /srv/data
evidence.summary: Shows successful PV/VG/LV creation and the initial 1.00 GiB ext4 logical volume mounted read-write at /srv/data.

evidence.requirement: Grow the logical volume to at least 2 GB while it remains mounted and contents remain intact
evidence.summary: Shows /srv/data mounted before and after growth, successful online expansion from 1.00 GiB to 2.25 GiB, a 2.2 GiB filesystem, and the unchanged proof-file checksum and content.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both initial and final evidence report Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart sequence and recovery for node1
evidence.summary: Captures healthy pre-restart state with boot ID 580ef1e3-1a76-40e4-bf11-bb5878259056, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 489f7e02-89f3-4f38-b993-bf954ddface3, and recovered OpenRC service, loop PV, 2.25 GiB LV, mounted filesystem, and checksum-identical data.
